authorisation: user brief 'ReST-GI - Worklog 50 DASQ Composable K: Controlled Integration, Stability, Fidelity, and Geometry-Edit Validation' (2026-10-27)
machine: LabServer69 (RTX 3090 24 GB) for every run; no cross-server timing comparison
frozen: K_k44P (sha256 30d55da3...) incl. K_loc, K_glob, band / mid for every non-Yellow receiver
C relations rel_T0 / rel_T1 / rel_T1_inc and rays
first_r1 / full r1 / hist references, views, masks
worklog-49 checkpoints and verdicts (L1 learned comparison stays formally INCONCLUSIVE)

gate0.wl49_l1_fluctuation: classified from the stored validation curves and deterministic re-evaluation of the final checkpoints (no retraining of the worklog-49 arms); worklog 49's verdict is unchanged

decomposition.Yellow receiver ports: domain A ports with material 0 (339k); pixels whose port is such a port
decomposition.K_loc: K44 unchanged: rho / pi E_tot + sum kappa / pi E_ind (port sender) / learned BSDF on gathers (pixel) + the sun's GGX lobe; owns the receiver's own port and local scattering
decomposition.K_glob: K44 unchanged rank-64 p(x) . gamma (all distances)
decomposition.in-support band + mid: REPLACED for Yellow receivers by N_arm (isotropic, linear in E_tot per channel, W from the matched network, elements = K44 representatives (L0) or DASQ alpha 1.0 (L1)); unchanged for every other receiver
decomposition.direct sun: enters every term only through E_tot = E_sun + E_ind (sun lobe in K_loc as production)
decomposition.boundary outgoing: port sender = K_loc + K_glob + (band + mid | N_arm) at the port normal (production semantics; N_arm is isotropic so its normal value equals every direction - a labelled domain-specific approximation for Yellow, worklog 47)
decomposition.units: E [W m^-2], outgoing radiance [W m^-2 sr^-1], N_arm = sum_e w_e [sr^-1 m^-2] * measure_e [m^2] * mean E_e

gate0.overlap_rule: arms are trained on r = Cycles probe col - K44 K_glob - K44 K_loc at Yellow pixels (shared target for L0 / L1), so K_loc / K_glob and N_arm cannot double count by construction; the self port is excluded from DASQ elements (K_loc owns it); no oracle / reference value at inference; no s_c or other scale
gate0.fields: the K44 band / mid input irradiance of each probe configuration (k44 batch_inputs, renderer-consistent visibility, scalar per port); splits = worklog 49 (fit 480 / val 120 prep2_train, test 120 prep2_holdout)

training.arms: L0 / L1, identical worklog-49 network (9,155 parameters), descriptors, objective (per-channel relative MSE of port-mean residuals), Adam lr 1e-3, cosine to 0, 30,000 steps, batch 8 configurations x 64 rows, seeds 5011 / 5012
training.fair_state: relative range of the last 5 validation-curve evaluations (fixed 30k val rows, every 1,000 steps) < 2 % for both arms of a seed; otherwise that seed's learned comparison is INCONCLUSIVE
training.budget_basis: worklog 49 profiling: 20k steps in 49 s with precomputed features; on-the-fly features here, expected <= 15 min per run

conditions.L0C: K44 + L0 arm replacing Yellow band + mid
conditions.L1C: K44 + L1 arm replacing Yellow band + mid

gate1.evaluation: r1_eval K_only vs first_r1 (held-out T0 and T1, all 16 views each)
gate1.primary: Yellow-pixel display PSNR, per view, L1C - L0C (both seeds)

criteria.first_event_advantage: mean L1C - L0C >= +0.3 dB with a 95 % view-bootstrap CI > 0, both seeds
criteria.integration_valid: non-Yellow pixels identical to H (by construction; tested) AND L*C Yellow-lit PSNR >= H Yellow-lit - 1.0 dB; else diagnose the interface and do not continue to Gate 3

gate2.method: c50_onestep: one production gather after the first event; single-flight indirect vs (full_r1 - first_r1) per class; first-event Yellow sender energy (port areas)
gate2.note: C is unchanged and was verified on a known field in worklogs 45 / 46; the frozen K44 full-directional sender is NOT used

gate3.solver: unchanged r1 State.solve (tol, max_it, growth rule); per view status / iterations / residual ratios; spectral radius by the production power iteration

criteria.convergence: all S_T0 / D_stale / E_upd / E_relfull solves converged for the arm
criteria.stop: a diverged or non-finite arm solve stops that arm's Gate 4 claims (evidence preserved)

gate4.metrics: r1_eval rows (S_T0 | r1 and | hist view-mean PSNR, materials, lit / shadow, signed change on A_changed / stationary) + c50_report (Yellow lit / shadow / 3-30 cm, indirect component vs full - first, observed / hidden)

criteria.coupled_advantage: S_T0 | r1 Yellow PSNR L1C - L0C >= +0.2 dB with a view-bootstrap CI > 0, both seeds
criteria.regression: opaque / box / glass PSNR change vs H within +-0.2 dB
criteria.edit: A_changed corr and slope reported; an improvement is corr +0.01 or |slope - 1| reduced by >= 0.05

gate5: timings: arm table construction, arm apply per call, solve / render per view, training; element counts; peak memory; T1 update = incremental relation (unchanged) + arm re-application only

budget.note: hard limits; seed 5012 complete evaluation is run only if the budget allows

tests: arm ownership: non-Yellow ports / pixels unchanged, keep mask
